20011121002201021 - ASI: 14

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  11 = 1 * 1
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  021 = 0 * 21
  0022 = 00 * 22
  0111 = 01 * 11
  00111 = 0 * 0111
  01021 = 01 * 021
  0011121 = 00111 * 21
  20011121 = 2 * 0011121
  002201021 = 0022 * 01021
  20011121002201021 = 20011121 * 002201021
